en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large corner building in an urban street. The structure has a steep tiled roof with dormer windows, tall vertical windows on a prominent hall wing, and a small dome-like tower. Young trees line the sidewalk and a low stone and metal fence surrounds the property. At the corner a street sign is visible, and above the tall windows on the gable end there is German text on the façade indicating the institution housed in the building.
